title_sq: Tek "Ekspozita Building" Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Cmim Kleringu!!
description_sq: Tek "Ekspozita Building" , Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Cmim Kleringu!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 16 te objektit 24 katesh. title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale at "Exposita Building", with Clearing Price!!
description_en: At "Exposita Building", Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with Clearing Price!!! The apartment is located on the 16th floor of a 24-storey building. The Multifunctional Building "Exhibition Building" has a strategic position on the edge of Gjergj Fishta Boulevard and is characterized by high quality construction and unique architecture. Premium building for the city of Tirana is interspersed with commercial service units, office premises and apartments. The apartment has a total area of ​​103.11 m2 and is organized in the entrance corridor which divides the premises, the living room together with the very spacious kitchen corner and with a spectacular view, completely with glass facades, a matrimonial room with its own toilet, a children's room and a day toilet.
